purpose: Test whether earlier shooter and opposing-goalie identities add predictive information beyond the frozen neutral probability and an identity-free intercept control.
fit: Joint convex Bernoulli log loss with frozen neutral logits as offsets and identity-centered L2 penalties. Fit once on each original earlier calibration period; no validation labels or online updating. Penalties are fixed Citrus regularization choices, not externally fitted constants or optimized hyperparameters.
source: Freshly replay unchanged official source and feature gates on exactly the previous calibration and validation populations. Join original source-rostered actor identities with the unchanged actor-attribution contract. Preserve all selected rows; unavailable or unseen actors get zero identity effect, not invented identity or a learned missing-actor effect.
guard: Primary joint candidate must have no worse Brier AND log loss than BOTH frozen_monotone and global_control in EACH earlier development fold. Shooter-only is a prespecified ablation, not a replacement selected after inspection. A passing development guard is not production acceptance.
evaluation: Retain all four models, original nine reliability bins, eight subgroup dimensions and every subgroup. Also retain identity support/fallback accounting by outcome and per-calendar-month diagnostics. No subset removal to improve results.
independence: Audit objective and projected gradients using independently constructed sparse matrices; reproduce every probability without the production predictor; verify future labels cannot be prediction inputs and validation game identities/dates are disjoint from every fit.
uncertainty: Original paired whole-game resampling holds fitted models fixed; it does not include refit uncertainty, actor cross-game dependence or adaptive-development multiplicity. Do not treat intervals as acceptance or league-comparative proof.
metric_semantics: An identity-conditioned forecast, distinct from neutral chance-quality xG. Actor effects are predictive associations, not causal isolated talent. In particular, opposing-goalie-conditioned probability must never replace the neutral expectation used to evaluate that goalie. All unblocked attempts remain included; this is not conditional-on-on-target xG.
research_scope: Public methodological motivation only. Implement Citrus's own penalized identity-offset model. No author performance result is adopted as a Citrus result; no MoneyPuck files, predictions or fitted constants are used.
limitations: Already-inspected earlier development seasons; not an untouched test or industry-superiority benchmark.
Frozen current source revisions do not establish historical-as-of actor or event availability.
The existing neutral model and probability map are not refit or relabeled; their conditional calibration weaknesses remain.
No player exposure, official actuals, season GSAx, rebound/continuation model, physical forecast or FPAR acceptance is implied.
All existing evidence, legacy artifacts, failed candidates and six prospective reservations remain byte-preserved.

Production accuracy improvements are user-authorized as of this request, but this development run cannot publish and requires independent quality, serving, migration and rollback gates before any rollout.
